data.name: Emmanuel
data.gender_notes: Emmanuel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Emmanuel is derived from the Hebrew words 'Immanu-El', which means 'God is with us'. It was given as a prophecy in the Old Testament (Isaiah 7:14) and was fulfilled when Jesus Christ was born. The name Emmanuel carries the meaning “God with us” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Emmanuel usually hope their child will grow to embody god with us and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emmanuel is a powerful name that symbolizes God's presence with us during challenging times. It reminds us of the promise that God will never abandon us.
data.etymology: Emmanuel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God with us.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emmanuel total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: עמנואל
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים עמנו, המשמעות הוא אלוהים הוא עמנו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם עמנואל הוא מילה עברית שמשמעותה 'אלוהים הוא עמנו'. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'עמנו' שמשמעותה 'עמנו' ו'אלוהים' שמשמעותה 'אלוהים'. השם הזה מופיע במקרא, בספר ישעיהו, פרק 7, פסוק 14, ומתייחס לנבואה על בואו של ישו המשיח. השם עמנואל הוא סמל לאמונה היהודית והנוצרית כאחד, ומשמעותו הרעיון שאלוהים הוא בקרבנו, תמיד עמנו.

in_greek.name: Εμμανουήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εμμανουήλ είναι ελληνική μετάφραση της εβραϊκής λέξης 'עמנואל', που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι μαζί μας'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Εμμανουήλ αναφέρεται στο κατά Ματθαίον Ευαγγέλιον, κεφάλαιο 1, εδάφιο 23, ως προφήτεία για την άφιξη του Ιησού Χριστού. Το όνομα Εμμανουήλ είναι σύμβολο της χριστιανικής πίστης και υπογραμμίζει την παρουσία του Θεού στην ανθρώπινη ιστορία.

in_latin.name: Emmanuel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Emmanuel significat 'Deus nobiscum' vel 'Deus est nobiscum'. Hoc nomen hebraicum est, quod in libro Isaiae, capitulo 7, versu 14, apparet ut prophetia de adventu Messiae. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Emmanuel fuit symbolum fidei christianae et testimonio praesentiae Dei in mundo. Hoc nomen etiam in liturgia et hymnis christianis saepe usurpatur.

in_english.name: Emmanuel
in_english.long_meaning: The name Emmanuel originates from the Hebrew 'עמנואל' (Immanuel), meaning 'God is with us'. This name appears in the Bible, specifically in Isaiah 7:14, as a prophecy regarding the coming of Jesus Christ. In Christian tradition, Emmanuel symbolizes the presence of God among humans. It signifies the fundamental Christian belief that God is with us, through Jesus Christ. The name has been used across various Christian cultures and is often associated with virtues such as faith, hope, and divine companionship.

data.cultural_impact: The name Emmanuel holds significant cultural value for Christians, as it represents the promise of God's presence with his people. It is a reminder of the assurance of God's guidance, comfort, and protection throughout our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Emmanuel represents the deep truth of God's love for humanity and his desire to be intimately involved in our lives. It serves as a reminder that even in the darkest moments, God is always present and never leaves us alone. The name Emmanuel is a powerful affirmation of God's promise to be with us, not just in word but in deed.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Emmanuel means "God with us." It symbolizes the divine presence and companionship of God in the lives of believers. In times of distress or doubt, the name serves as a reminder that God is not distant, but rather, is intimately involved in our daily struggles and triumphs.
